svg.text: Which commit a promotion-history assertion reads
One promotion, two commits: the landing, then the release receipt on top of it. HEAD names the receipt.
seed commit
fixture tree
promote(<run_id>): passed
the landing: the run's row and the plan comment
release(<run_id>): record workspace outcome
the receipt, and what HEAD names
Before the repair: the default revision
_landing_commit_paths(repository)
resolves HEAD, so it reads the receipt and not the landing.
It passed only because the receipt stages the same single
run file the landing does: a latent mislabel, green at base.
After the repair: the located landing
_landing_commit_paths(repository,
_promotion_commit(repository, run_id))
locates the promote(<run_id>): commit by its subject and
measures that commit, which is the landing itself.
Under the declared mutation: the release receipt stages a second path
receipt (HEAD): docs/state/proj/runs/<run_id>.json + <run_id>.receipt.txt
the default-revision form fails here, naming the receipt path HEAD carries that the landing does not
landing: docs/state/proj/runs/<run_id>.json
the repaired assertion passes here, because the landing names its single path
